name: Honjō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Honjō city emblem in green, blue and red: a green stylised figure with raised arms above a blue oval, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Honjō, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 October 2006.

features.role: Honjō city emblem — a green stylised figure with raised arms above a blue oval, with a red disc
